description: Dutch vocabulary register audit list. 'formal' = schrijftaal (written-only) item dead in conversation; 'preferred' = what Dutch speakers actually say. Deck defaults: je casual / u formal. Severity: 'high' = dead in speech, swap wherever it appears in conversational cards; 'medium' = written-leaning, swap in beginner content. See docs/dutch-register-policy.md.

schrijftaal.rationale: The classic Dutch written-only word list; every style guide flags these as never-spoken.

entries.note: Survives on shop signs («heden gesloten») and in «heden ten dage» (itself formal). Speech says vandaag.
Written conditional; contracts and forms. Speech always uses als.
Archaic-formal; alive only in hyper-polite correspondence and irony.
